Because `streamObject` validates the entire object, strict `lat`/`lng` bounds in the Zod schema would reject an entire itinerary over a single bad number. Filtering in `ItineraryView` keeps failures local—resulting in one missing map pin instead of an empty screen.

(Sources: resume, AI Travel Planner README)
